sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A platform fight with edges you can fall off, layered with a second "demonic realm" storyline: Saul D'Alessio is a prisoner being tormented by demonic copies of himself, and each health threshold introduces a new copy with its own puzzle. 12-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Opening & Saul's copies
bullets: At the start, Greed and Pride images walk toward Saul — break 4 demonic chains to free him. Only a few players (commonly 3) typically go into these demonic-realm phases; the rest hold the main platform.
Thief copy (~75%): tries to steal boons — break its defiance bar to stop it.

Gambler copy (~50%): summons 3 clones — identify the real one by weapon (a specific staff = real, a specific treasured bough = fake) rather than guessing. Greed and Pride reappear here too and explode on Saul for real damage if not handled.
Drunkard copy (~25%): teleports squad members around if its defiance bar isn't broken quickly — sometimes straight into an oil field, so don't let it sit.

sections.heading: Demonic Projection (tears, from 75%)
bullets: <mark>Demonic Projection</mark> shoots tears out at player locations every 15 seconds — close one by walking into it. Each player has a 1-minute cooldown after closing a tear, so spread the duty across the squad.
The projectiles tears fire can't be blocked and ignore protection — don't rely on defensives to sit in one.

sections.heading: Annihilate ("pizza")
bullets: Roughly every 20 seconds Deimos uses <mark>Annihilate</mark>, smashing his flails down and sending a cascading knockback around the arena from front to back — telegraphed by an orange segmented circle.

Dodge toward the boss's front, or stay within a single segment, to avoid the damage (you'll still get knocked back either way). A block reduces damage but doesn't stop the knockback — mind the platform edge.

sections.heading: Mind Crush & Saul's ward
bullets: From around 90% health, <mark>Mind Crush</mark> targets everyone on the platform roughly every 40 seconds — it can't be evaded or blocked. After a 5-second channel, anyone hit is instantly downed.
Saul drops a protective dome at the center that blocks it — get inside. Outside the dome (even with defensives up) still takes 70% max HP over 10 seconds.

During the oil phase, tank Deimos away from center rather than on top of it — oils target whoever's closest to Deimos besides the tank, and keeping the boss off-center keeps Saul's ward accessible to everyone else.

sections.heading: Rapid Decay (oils, from 60%)
bullets: <mark>Rapid Decay</mark> drops oil fields on the closest non-tank player to Deimos, telegraphed by orange circles that expand over 30 seconds and grow further with each player hit — new ones spawn every 15 seconds. A fully expanded oil is generally a wipe, so pop it or move the fight before that happens.
<mark>Soul Feast</mark> creates additional deadly zones around the room that periodically get consumed — treat these with the same caution as the oils.

sections.heading: Final phase (from ~10%)
bullets: Deimos goes invulnerable and transforms into a structure — Annihilate and Mind Crush stop, but hands and oil circles keep spawning.

He alternates single-hand slams with a double-hand slam, each knocking back unless mitigated with Stability or Aegis. Keep clearing hands and oils through this phase rather than assuming it's a breather.

sections.heading: Targeting & Enrage
bullets: Deimos fixates the highest-toughness player; the demonic copies target players by other traits (precision, etc.) depending on which copy is active.
12:00 — Deimos deals +200% damage past this point.
